results.notes: Given: card shows span[aria-hidden] "L" (h-8 w-8, bg-green-500), website field empty. results.title: TC-GEO-1262-008 - Lettermark is shown when the favicon fails to load

steps.title: Given the custom brand "Lictorix Geo" is selected with an empty website field
When request blocking is on for "s2/favicons" and the user enters a domain with no brand logo and the field loses focus
steps.expected: The grey pulsing placeholder is shown

steps.title: Then the neutral lettermark is shown as the brand visual
steps.expected: The 32px avatar shows the letter "L", same letter avatar as the dashboard

steps.title: And the domain is shown under the brand name

results.notes: Request blocking was done via a Playwright route - page.context().route('**/s2/favicons**', r => r.abort()) - registered BEFORE entering the website (equivalent of DevTools request blocking for "s2/favicons"). One request aborted: https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain=example.com&sz=64. Given: website field cleared and committed on blur, card back to span "L" with no img. When: placeholder [data-testid=wizard-brand-logo-placeholder] (animate-pulse, bg-slate-200) visible in step2_when (brands/logo response delayed 2.5 s with a Playwright route, test aid only, response unchanged). Then: no img in the card; span[aria-hidden] "L" 32x32, classes "inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center font-medium text-white h-8 w-8 rounded-full text-sm bg-green-500" - identical component/classes to the dashboard letter avatars (e.g. "B", "E", "K", "L" rows, 32px; background colour varies per brand name). "example.com" shown under "Lictorix Geo". Cleanup: page.context().unrouteAll() + page.unrouteAll(); re-entering example.com then rendered the s2/favicons img again (complete, natural 16px) and a direct s2/favicons load for google.com succeeded (64px) - no leftover route.
